communication.description: Generic interaction patterns between a person and an agent, and between an orchestrating agent and its sub-agents.

core.description: Skills that teach an agent about sous itself: what sous manages, how its configuration works, how templates render, and how skills are written. Auto-subscribed in every project, with opt-out-only semantics.

tool-usage.description: Recipes that teach an agent to drive an external tool, together with the scripts and references that tool needs.

workflow.description: Task tracking, branch conventions and issue-board practice: the recipes that shape how a unit of work starts, is recorded, and finishes.
